Details: %1$s

What this sends: Krunk contacts %1$s only when you tap \"Check for updates\" (it fetches the update information and its signature) and when you tap \"Download and install\" (it fetches the one APK for this device). The requests carry nothing but the request itself and the User-Agent \"Krunk-Android/%2$s\": no identifiers, no cookies, no settings. The server sees your IP address, as with any request. Krunk checks the signature with the key built into it, and the APK\'s size, SHA-256, package and signing certificate, before Android\'s installer asks you.
Allow Krunk to install the update?

Android asks once whether Krunk may install apps. Krunk uses this only to hand Android the Krunk update you just downloaded and that passed every check; Android still asks you before it installs. On the next screen, switch on \"Allow from this source\", then come back.
